args.name: selection
args.description: The columns to operate on. See 'qsv select --help' for the selection syntax.

args.name: input
args.description: Input CSV file. If not specified, reads from stdin.

options.description: Fill initial empty values with the first valid value.
The field delimiter for reading CSV data. Must be a single character. (default: ,)
Fill using the first valid value of a column, instead of the latest.
When set, the first row will not be interpreted as headers. (i.e., They are not searched, analyzed, sliced, etc.)
Write output to <file> instead of stdout.
